items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I wrote some original tunes which I recorded with one of his groups... I put them in his Corporation. Later on, he reassigned my tunes. He gave them back to me

ctx.x: Thank Music Corp, yes. I asked you if GG Grice had any influence on you doing that.

GG, of course, had a publishing company. I forget the name of it. But, I wrote some original tunes which I recorded with one of his groups, or one of my groups at the time. At the time, my company didn't exist. I put them in his Corporation. Later on, he reassigned my tunes. He gave them back to me and I assigned them to Thank. I thought it was a very nice thing to do because some publishers won't do that. I'm thinking of one in particular that used to be connected with a certain record company. But, sometimes…
It seems like Grice was a forward thinking musician. He viewed this as a path to empowerment.
